title: Five faces: rule labels only where the rule is trustworthy (buildings, walls, ground)
why: faces-v0 (no labels) gets furniture right but turns house walls, roofs and the lab's back wall into floor. faces-v3 (rule labels) gets buildings right but furniture wrong. Use the rule only for labels that are whole-tile and unambiguous.
changes: Real maps back in (half of each batch), rule labels only for: ground, lawn, tall-grass, flower, water, shore, bridge, floor, roof, wall, wall-interior, window, door, picture
No rule labels for furniture, machines, shelves, statues, signs, plants, trees, rocks, cliffs, ledges, fences or stairs
